hook: Zero-shot forecasting wins, but not everywhere.
hookText: Zero-shot forecasting wins, but not everywhere

beats.say: Google's TimesFM 3 leads the public benchmarks, but those benchmarks use old public data the model may already have seen during training.
The author tested it on data published after its release, sealed forecasts, and seven thousand six hundred synthetic series, with the protocol frozen first.
The model wins, but not everywhere, and its prediction intervals come out narrower than they claim to be.
